description: Batch counterpart to get_hospital_provider_code_costs: one hospital's provider charges for 1 to 100 codes in a single call, results in request order. A code the hospital doesn't charge is an entry with no costs, not an error. Backed by the hospital-prices serving snapshot; fails with UNAVAILABLE until the server has opened one.

filter.description: Keeps only some of the grouped rows (see group_by). Each field left out matches any value; set a field (even to its *_UNSPECIFIED value, which means 'not filed') to require it. Billing classes are never blended: a facility fee and a professional fee are separate bills.

group_by.description: Which rows exist: one per billing class + methodology + setting (GROUP_BY_PER_COMBINATION, the default), per billing class, per methodology, or GROUP_BY_ALL (one figure over everything, blending billing classes), or GROUP_BY_FACILITY_PLUS_PROFESSIONAL (one row per methodology and setting the hospital files under both the facility and the professional billing class, the two added together, i.e. the combined bill; terms are methodology and setting, no billing class; no row where there is no professional counterpart). Applied before filter, which may name only the terms the grouping still keeps (e.g. GROUP_BY_BILLING_CLASS with a methodology filter, or GROUP_BY_ALL with any filter, is rejected as INVALID_ARGUMENT).

revision_id.description: Optional. A revision_id from list_hospitals. Omit for the latest revision.

name: batch_get_hospital_provider_code_costs
title: Batch get a hospital's provider charges
